summary: OVMF prerequisite probes require a readable regular code image

faults.name: linux-nonempty
faults.summary: linux accepts a nonempty path without checking the file

edits.find:
need OVMF
probe . tools/setup/ovmf_path.sh && [ -f "$OVMF_CODE" ] && [ -r "$OVMF_CODE" ]
admin apt-get install -y ovmf
edits.replace:
need OVMF
probe . tools/setup/ovmf_path.sh && [ -n "$OVMF_CODE" ]
admin apt-get install -y ovmf

faults.name: macos-nonempty
faults.summary: macos accepts a nonempty path without checking the file

edits.find:
need OVMF
probe . tools/setup/ovmf_path.sh && [ -f "$OVMF_CODE" ] && [ -r "$OVMF_CODE" ]
user brew install qemu
edits.replace:
need OVMF
probe . tools/setup/ovmf_path.sh && [ -n "$OVMF_CODE" ]
user brew install qemu
